torque_convention: Signed +Z moment of solver reported boundary force: sum((X+U) cross RF)_z / 1000; coordinates mm, forces N. A resisting spring torque on the driver has the opposite sign. INNER/OUTER sign is retained, not rectified.
stress_convention: Von Mises computed from FRD nodally averaged/extrapolated STRESS tensor SXX,SYY,SZZ,SXY,SYZ,SZX. Not an integration-point maximum.
strain_convention: TOSTRAIN total Lagrangian strain for the declared elastic material; principal values of the symmetric reported tensor.
contact_convention: CPRESS/COPEN retain solver signs. Negative normal displacement is reported penetration; pressure positive. FRD nodal contact values and DAT contact-element values are separate because face-contact nodal output may remain zero despite nonzero DAT pressure. peak_pressure_MPa selects the maximum actually printed value. No absent contact value is inferred zero. Nominal gap is pitch/arms minus strip width, not a measured minimum curved gap.
time_convention: One unit-duration quasi-static load parameter, not elapsed physical animation time; prescribed theta=target_deg*time.

analysis_scope.contact_scope: Explicitly declared opposite-arm element-face surfaces only; same-arm self-contact excluded. See contact coverage and deformed-section checks.

manual_reference: https://www.dhondt.de/ccx_2.21.pdf section 7.51 EL FILE, printed page 483: nodal averaging and elastic TOSTRAIN definition; locally verified in ccx_2.21-primary-manual.txt lines 24282-24295
limits: Source-formula representative two-identical-arm cartridge; not the two native weak/strong CAD parts.
Linear elastic material with geometric nonlinearity; no plasticity, yield-strength, fatigue-life or manufacturing validation.
No mesh convergence or experimental validation is implied.
Contact fields/tables are included only when actually printed. Missing values are null/absent, never inferred zero.
No uncomputed angle, failed increment, synthetic initial frame or temporally interpolated stress frame is exported.

full_field_archive.format: gzip JSON; same frames including full nodal stress_MPa, strain, contact_fields and DAT tables

_binary.displayPrecision: Original float64 node coordinates; float32 displacement and stress for display only. All scalar quantitative values retained unchanged in JSON.
